diwali-2026.title: Diwali weekend
diwali-2026._source: Diwali Sun 8 Nov 2026: Amavasya with the Sun in sidereal Libra, new moon 9 Nov 12:32 IST, Amavasya covers the 8 Nov evening (pyswisseph, computed 2026-10-21; Adhika Masa year, so not recalled). Pairs: trap has 11 in crowd_calendar.peak_months or avoid_weekends=true, swap row with distance/drive where we have one, queried 2026-10-21. Jaipur note itself says 'Diwali weekend is lovely but packed'. Manali left out: its note calls Sep-Nov the quiet sweet spot.

guru-nanak-2026.title: Guru Nanak Jayanti long weekend
guru-nanak-2026._source: Guru Nanak Jayanti = Kartik Purnima: full moon 24 Nov 20:23 IST, Sun in sidereal Scorpio, Purnima at sunrise Tue 24 Nov (pyswisseph, 2026-10-21). Sat 21-Tue 24 with Mon 23 as the bridge day. Pairs from crowd_calendar (11 in peak_months or avoid_weekends) + tourist_trap_alternatives, queried 2026-10-21. Pushkar left out: Kartik Purnima is its own fair week and Ajmer is not a quiet swap. Jaipur dropped (its crowd line is about Diwali) and Amritsar dropped (our note calls the Golden Temple manageable, and Gurpurab is why people go). 10-21 eyeball: Dhanaulti (shrub close-up) and Chitrakoot (packed Ramghat aarti under 'go here instead') swapped for Chakrata and Orchha.
